title: What Is Optometry?
description: What is optometry, really? In this debut episode of Focus Cast by focuslinks.in, our host and Dr. Meera unpack the true definition of optometry, trace its journey from medieval spectacle makers to a modern university-taught health profession, bust the biggest myths about what optometrists actually do, and explain why this profession sits at the front line of global eye care. The perfect first lesson for optometry students, optical staff, and curious patients.
